english.title: Stormproof Cities
english.description: Gathering Storm only. All governors, including those of AI players, start with Liang’s Reinforced Materials effect. Once a governor is established in a city, environmental effects cannot damage that city’s improvements, buildings, or districts.

schinese.title: 安如磐石
schinese.description: 仅限风云变幻。人类和 AI 玩家的所有总督初始都拥有梁的「加固材料」效果。总督就职后，环境效应无法损坏该城市的改良设施、建筑与区域。
